sloka: प्राप्तां सुमहतीं प्रीतिं प्रतीतां तां हतद्विषम् ।उपस्थास्यसि कौसल्यां दासीवत्त्वं कृताञ्जलिः ॥२-८-१०॥
transliteration: prāptāṁ sumahatīṁ prītiṁ pratītāṁ tāṁ hatadviṣam ।upasthāsyasi kausalyāṁ dāsīvattvaṁ kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥2-8-10॥

translations.english: With folded palms like an attendant, you will have to serve that renowned Kausalya who is greatlly delighted by getting rid of her enemies.
